name: Equasens Société anonyme
summary: Equasens Société anonyme provides healthcare IT solutions in France, Italy, Belgium, Germany, the United Kingdom, and internationally. The company operates through Sales of Configurations and Hardware, Maintenance Services and Subscriptions, and Software and Services segments. The company engages in publishing and distribution of pharmacy, practice, management software and related offerings for pharmacies, medical-social establishments, doctors, and medical auxiliaries; distribution of computer equipment, turnkey installation and training; after-sales services, and telephone support and maintenance; and data backup, intermediation, and vocational training services.
